name: I'll Be Back
source:
On a dark night a person in white suit and forehead dripping with blood appears before a boy. No one knows where they are going to.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
漆黑的夜里，一名身穿白色西装、额头淌着鲜血的人出现在少年面前。没有人知道他们将前往何方。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
